name: Christiana Pub
description: Christiana Pub is a lively karaoke bar known for its friendly atmosphere and regular karaoke nights on Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday. The venue offers a welcoming environment with great live music, a good selection of drinks, and a spacious layout that includes a covered back deck. Its community vibe makes it a popular spot for locals and visitors alike to sing, socialize, and enjoy good food and drinks in a relaxed setting.
